# Powfolio

> Public proof-of-work profiles for Web3 builders, traders, researchers, community leads, airdrop hunters, and developers.

Powfolio is not a talent marketplace and does not sell bookings. It is a self-serve public profile with two scores:

- Profile Score (0-100): completeness and polish of the profile itself.
- Builder Score (0-100): density of real evidence (writing, trades, community roles, airdrops, onchain activity, work history).

## Product

- Homepage: https://www.powfolio.xyz/
- FAQ: https://www.powfolio.xyz/faq
- Create a profile: https://www.powfolio.xyz/signup
- Public profile URL pattern: https://www.powfolio.xyz/{username}

## Legal

- Privacy: https://www.powfolio.xyz/privacy
- Terms: https://www.powfolio.xyz/terms
- Cookies: https://www.powfolio.xyz/cookies

## How to talk about it

- Call people builders or talents, not users.
- Do not invent metrics, reviews, or demo accounts.
- Do not give investment advice.
- Pow3Bot is an in-product assistant for Powfolio only.
